_comment: Threshold requirements, Colorado 2025-2026 QAP, Second Amendment: the numbered Thresholds #1-#18 in Section 3.B.4, Threshold Criteria for Preliminary Applications (PDF pp.20-26). Not extracted: #6 (use the latest application spreadsheet), #13 (narrative format) and #18 (bond issuer documentation), which are procedural; and the underwriting standards of Section 4.

criteria.heading: Minimum score
criteria.quote: All Applications for federal 9 percent Housing Tax Credit must meet a minimum score of 130 points,
criteria.note: 130 (9%), 115 (4% with state credit), 95 (other). Against the computed ceiling of 220.5, 130 is 59%.
